Type: braided storage baskets, set of three
Use: storing blankets, toys or magazines; living room, bedroom, home office, on the floor or shelf
Style: coastal, bohemian, Scandinavian
Materials: braided jute and cotton
Colors: cream white, natural tan stripes
Shape: round cylindrical baskets in nesting sizes, wide horizontal stripes, cut-out handles, soft braided rim
Feel: warm, casual, natural
Goes with: light wood, white walls, linen textiles; coastal, boho or Scandinavian rooms

product.name: Amazon Brand – Rivet Modern Braided Stripe Round Basket Set - Set of 3, Natural
product.description: The timeless charm of hand-braided basketry takes new form thanks to the precision of machinery. The 2 tones give these 3 baskets an artistic flair, and their handles make them great for transporting home goods. Jute Designated for storage and transport of home goods Basket measurements are 14” x 14” x 14”, 10” x 10” x 10”, 6” x 6” x 6”
